levers.name: CCL options
levers.reason: the reduce-scatter winner of the P0 quick sweep on four cards (FABRIC_1D, payload 4352, image tp4-octo2-1): chunks_per_sync=1 on the 128 unit-major reduce-scatters a pass cut the in-trace call from 16.87 to 14.74 us (-2.14 us, 5 of 5 paired rounds, A/A noise 0.08 us) with the input in DRAM and in L1, and was bit-exact against the sequential engine's own one-tile call. The model passes 10, more than a worker has chunks, so every iteration signalled once at its end; 1 lets the receiver start reducing the first chunk while the next is in flight. Exact by construction (the ring's chunk parity is a function of the tile index, not of the sync cadence). A reduce-scatter-only set leaves DistributedNorm.forward unwrapped. It needs QWEN_FAST_TP4_RS_UNIT_MAJOR=1, which the production profile sets.

profiles.name: ccl-served
profiles.reason: the A/A control of the plumbing: the unit-major reduce-scatter hook and the DistributedNorm gather shim engaged with an EMPTY set, so every call carries the values the model passes today; its timed pair is the control-to-control floor of the plumbing and it must be byte-identical to the production profile

profiles.name: ccl-served-audit
profiles.reason: the plumbing control audited: every audited call is compared with itself on the device (a harness that cannot see a difference reads exact=True here, so a mismatch in the sets' audits is a finding about the set, not about the audit)

notes: F-C1. LEVER VALUE rs-c1 (P0 result): the other P0 values lost (rs-b1 -3.0 us, rs-l1 -5.4 us, rs-w1 -2.9 us slower, rs-c5 about 0), so the sets with several options are not worth a lever until P1 (c2, c20, c50, b3, b4, w4 and the combinations) says otherwise; the gather options were NOT timed by P0 (the probe's reference was wrong, fixed on this branch: the host tilizer canonicalises -0 and denormals, and the reference is now the same upload and download). No tp_addresses row: tile_collective_tp.install() (already called by tp_addresses.install) binds the gather shim when the set names a gather option (or is 'served') and puts it back through the same list; a reduce-scatter-only set binds nothing there. INTEGRATOR: (1) set nothing else; the value is the lever's, the twins are -fx-ccl and -fx-ccl-audit, and 'rs-c1' is the string for fx-all; (2) the probe launch needs scripts/ci/fusion-wp/WP5-fabric-probe.patch (FABRIC_PROBES in c2_serving_job.py and the case in qwen-c2-serving.yml; test_ccl_options_jobs holds that it applies); (3) the sweep, hang 5/5 and plumbing templates are scripts/ci/references/fusion-jobs-wp5 (a sibling folder: test_tp4_fusion_jobs reads every entry of fusion-jobs as a file), generated by optimisation/ttnn-op/ccl_sweep/make_pack.py; (4) ccl-served is not a lever of the generated pack: its two profiles are for the WP5 plumbing job CCLS.
